answer: Rather than prove who you are, the network asks what you can still produce, on a seeded ridge that changes every epoch. Every checkpoint root is anchored to a public chain and the full history replays for anyone. That makes each attestation permanently attributable: a island that vouched for junk is a timestamped record the audit lanes can act on later. So a copper of identities is a subscription, not an acquisition: it bills the operator every epoch and refunds nothing when the panel disagrees. Seal h1sqb.
